title: Northbeam TechWorks Cover Liaison: What a ShieldCare Plan Has Met of the Work
content:
What the plan has met of the same work on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is read from the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans covering the item — the plan's standing and the decision recorded against its claim — and, failing those, from what stands written off to the plan's cover on the job.

**Where the plan covering the item stands active and the decision recorded against its claim refused the claim**, nothing is taken off, because a refused claim has met nothing of the work.

**Where the plan stands active and that decision approved a repair**, what the plan has already paid out on the item is taken off.

**Where neither situation holds**, what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job is taken off.

## The readings side by side

| The plan covering the item | The decision recorded against its claim | Taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| standing active | refused the claim | nothing |
| standing active | approved a repair | what the plan has already paid out on the item |
| standing active | any other outcome recorded | what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job |
| not standing active | any | what has been written off to the plan's cover on the job |

A decision that approved a replacement, approved a reimbursement or was withdrawn by the customer is neither a refusal nor an approved repair, so it falls to the third line.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job or plan on file.*

**No plan standing active and nothing written off to the plan's cover.** Nothing is taken off.

**No plan standing active, a plan write-off on the job.** The third reading governs, and the 73.20 USD written off to the plan's cover on the job is taken off.

**An approved repair.** The plan stands active, a repair was approved, and 264.50 USD has already been paid out on the item. 264.50 USD is taken off.

**A refused claim.** The plan covering the item stands active and its claim was refused. Nothing is taken off, even where a write-off on the plan's cover stands on the job.
